   60   def pbInitialize(pkmn, idxParty, batonPass = false)

   93   def pbInitEffects(batonPass)
   94     if batonPass
   95       # These effects are passed on if Baton Pass is used, but they need to be
   96       # reapplied
   97       @effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus] = (@effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus] > 0) ? 2 : 0
   98       @effects[PBEffects::LockOn]     = (@effects[PBEffects::LockOn] > 0) ? 2 : 0
   99       if @effects[PBEffects::PowerTrick]
  100         @attack, @defense = @defense, @attack
  101       end
  102       # These effects are passed on if Baton Pass is used, but they need to be
  103       # cancelled in certain circumstances anyway
  104       @effects[PBEffects::Telekinesis] = 0 if isSpecies?(:GENGAR) && mega?
  105       @effects[PBEffects::GastroAcid]  = false if unstoppableAbility?
  106     else
  107       # These effects are passed on if Baton Pass is used
  108       GameData::Stat.each_battle { |stat| @stages[stat.id] = 0 }
  109       @effects[PBEffects::AquaRing]          = false
  110       @effects[PBEffects::Confusion]         = 0
  111       @effects[PBEffects::Curse]             = false
  112       @effects[PBEffects::Embargo]           = 0

  115       @effects[PBEffects::HealBlock]         = 0

  117       @effects[PBEffects::LaserFocus]        = 0
